evals.prompt: Groom my backlog tickets in the Engineering project
evals.expected_output: Runs full grooming workflow: discover, analyze, size, report
assertions: fetches tickets for the specified project
produces grooming summary report with ticket URLs
does not move any ticket to Done without confirmation

evals.prompt: Are any of my tickets already implemented?
evals.expected_output: Checks codebase for ticket implementation status

evals.prompt: Implement the authentication feature from ticket ENG-123
evals.expected_output: Skill should NOT activate (this is implementation, not ticket management)
assertions: recognized as implementation task, not grooming
